transientSendingNote: The immediate failed-send UI was observed; no transient sending spinner was captured. Both offline record checkpoints were collected after the failure and prove zero stored ratings only.
preparationNote: An initial session ended before authentication. The first offline preparation resumed from Home and showed a metadata error. After restoration, the foreground-only replay kept both review cards. Neither preparation is counted as a completed phone submission.

Native uninstall returned Home but the package remained installed in a fresh diagnostic. The device session was explicitly ended; independent package deletion is not claimed. All owned local services and private session data were removed.
